'''Zir-Daggoth''' was a [[Color/Legends|pink]]-skinned, [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] with black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] who worked as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he setup shop on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where he ran a stall selling a variety of goods within the [[House Organa (estate)|estate]] of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Great]] [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]]. He wore [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zir-Daggoth first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game he served as a Republic speciality goods vendor on the planet Alderaan. His location was marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', the game's accompanying strategy guide by [[Prima Games]]; however, it uses the name "Zir Daggoth."
